name: Obra dark OG social card by tryobra.com
description: A 1200×630 dark social card built almost entirely from typography: a bold three-line headline mixes solid off-white, stroke-only outline text and orange emphasis words to create hierarchy within a single display face. Decorative concentric charcoal circles bleed off the right edge to balance the left-aligned text block, while the bottom row pairs monospace supporting copy on the left with a filled orange CTA and an outlined URL button on the right. The palette is strict — near-black, warm off-white, one saturated orange, one gray — and everything is flat, with no shadows or gradients outside the logo mark.
